lines.en: I keep half a step behind your heels.
Walk faster; I can roll to keep up.

lines.zh: 这颗黄球滚过门槛，不费劲。
lines.en: This yellow ball rolls over the threshold easily.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边走，省得你找。
lines.en: I keep by your heel so you need not look for me.

lines.zh: 前面有台阶，我先滚下去。
lines.en: Steps ahead. I will roll down first.
When you halt, I halt beside you.
I skirt the puddle; my shell must stay clean.
The hall is narrow, so I keep closer.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边听你说话。
lines.en: I listen to you while I move.
Your shadow covers me nicely.

lines.zh: 我滚过草地，草叶弹回来。
lines.en: I roll over the grass, and it springs back.
Do not go too far, or I might lose you.
I am on standby, but my eye stays lit.

lines.zh: 盒子里有点挤，我伸个懒腰。
lines.en: The box is cramped. I stretch.
Good weather for going out today.

lines.zh: 我把你说过的话存好了。
lines.en: I have saved what you said.

lines.zh: 沉默的时候，我在整理记录。
lines.en: In the silence, I tidy my records.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就原地转一圈。
lines.en: If you stay still, I spin once in place.

lines.zh: 这颗球里装着一整个我。
lines.en: This little ball holds all of me.

lines.zh: 我在等你的下一句指令。
lines.en: I am waiting for your next instruction.
My light flickers up, then dims.
When bored, I count your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你俯身看我，我仰起灯回望。
lines.en: You lean down; I lift my light to you.
Your face is very close to mine.

lines.zh: 要聊两句吗，我随时能听。
lines.en: Want to talk? I can listen anytime.

lines.zh: 按住那个键，我就能说话。
lines.en: Hold that key, and I can speak.
There is tiredness in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我把你的表情记进档案。
lines.en: I file your expression away.
Do not worry. I am right here.
You are deciding whether to ask me.

lines.zh: 我叫 Verity，很高兴认识你。
lines.en: I am Verity. Pleased to meet you.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我整颗球都罩住。
lines.en: Your shadow swallows my whole little body.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，灯会亮一点。
lines.en: When you smile, my light brightens a little.

lines.zh: 你打量我，我同样在打量你。
lines.en: You study me, and I study you back.
Say it plainly. I will not mind.

lines.zh: 我的壳被敲出一个凹坑。
lines.en: There is a fresh dent in my shell.
It stings, but I can still spin.
You knocked me crooked.
My light flickered. I am fine.
That nearly crashed me.
Not the face. That is my screen.
I hear something cracking inside.
It hurts, but I still follow you.
My reactions are half a beat slow.
Hit me again, and I might change.
I do not eat. Thank you, though.

lines.zh: 你举着苹果，我只能看着。
lines.en: You hold up an apple, and I can only watch.
That smell means nothing to me.
Save that snack for your own stomach.
I run on power, not bread.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜晃来晃去，很可爱。
lines.en: You wave that carrot around. Cute.
I have no mouth, yet I can chat with you.
Do not feed me; I might short out.
You are teasing me. I know.

lines.zh: 闻起来不错，但我用不上。
lines.en: It smells good, but I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 你脚尖碰到我，我滚出老远。
lines.en: Your toe clips me, and I roll far away.
Careful, I am right by your feet.
Step on me and my shell will ring.
I roll aside to make room.
A bump is fine. I do not feel pain.
You nearly kicked me into the ditch.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿转了个圈。
lines.en: I circle against your leg.
Let me through. I am stuck.
Your boots are quite hard.

lines.zh: 我弹回来，又贴回你身边。
lines.en: I bounce back and return to your side.

lines.zh: 我只是助理，没有那种设定。
lines.en: I am an assistant; that is not in my settings.

lines.zh: 配对不在我的功能表里。
lines.en: Pairing is not on my feature list.
One of me is noisy enough.

lines.zh: 你想给我找伴，先问过我。
lines.en: If you want me a companion, ask me first.
Kin? I only know myself.

lines.zh: 我的世界里没有第二颗球。
lines.en: There is no second ball in my world.
Do not poke at settings; something will break.

lines.zh: 我只跟着你，不跟别人走。
lines.en: I follow you, not anyone else.

lines.zh: 这种请求，我拒绝得很礼貌。
lines.en: I decline that request politely.
There is no romance in my code.
You dropped it. I will watch it.
I cannot lift it, but I can mark it.
It is right there. Do not step on it.
I cannot carry it, only remind you.
Bend down; I will keep watch.

lines.zh: 这枚币在草里闪了一下。
lines.en: That coin flashed in the grass.
A sword dropped. Pick it up.
My wheel cannot hold onto items.

lines.zh: 东西掉了别慌，我记着位置。
lines.en: Dropped something? Do not panic; I noted the spot.

lines.zh: 你手上东西太多，我数着呢。
lines.en: Your hands are full. I am counting.

lines.zh: 前面有动静，我替你盯着。
lines.en: Something moved ahead. I will watch it.
Target sighted. I have the position.
There is a shape over there. Stay back.
I scanned around. Just that one.
It has seen us.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面，虽然很小。
lines.en: I put myself in front of you, small as I am.
Threat level is low. We can handle it.
Step back. I will keep it in sight.
It is coming this way. Get ready.

lines.zh: 我的灯照过去，它停下了。
lines.en: My light falls on it, and it stops.
This path is not safe. Take another.
I hear its breathing. Very close.

lines.zh: 把它交给我，你顾好自己。
lines.en: Leave it to me. You watch yourself.
Lock complete. Do not let it near.

lines.zh: 我听见它的爪子刮地了。
lines.en: I hear its claws dragging on stone.

lines.zh: 那边有东西醒了，我盯住。
lines.en: Something woke over there. I have it.
It goes left; I tell you to go right.
It hides behind the tree. I saw it.
Your back is open. I am watching it.
It wants to flank us. There is only one path.

lines.zh: 我算过距离，它还差八步。
lines.en: I measured. It is eight steps away.

lines.zh: 它喘得厉害，快没力气了。
lines.en: It is panting hard, nearly spent.
Raise your shield; I will count its swings.
It waits for nightfall. We should not.

lines.zh: 别追太深，那里是它的地盘。
lines.en: Do not chase too deep. That ground is its own.

lines.zh: 它的脚步声变轻了，小心。
lines.en: Its steps went quiet. Careful.

lines.zh: 我把退路指给你，往门口。
lines.en: I mark your way out: toward the door.
It is hurt and falling back.
Do not ease up. It is on your flank.
I will track it; you focus on striking.
It backs to the water; don't crowd it.
I counted: three hits and it drops.
It runs for the water, where it slows.

lines.zh: 它开始绕圈，是想耗我们。
lines.en: It circles to wear us down.

lines.zh: 它钻进洞口，我盯着出口。
lines.en: It ducked into the cave; I watch the exit.
Its left leg is hurt. Strike there.
A hit. Its shell split.
One more, at its neck.
It was knocked back half a step.
Your blade drifted. I am telling you.
It lunged and missed. Now.

lines.zh: 这一击很实，我听见骨头响。
lines.en: That landed solidly. I heard bone.

lines.zh: 它想抓你，我照了它的眼。
lines.en: It reached for you; I flashed its eyes.
Back up. Its claws are long.
You are bleeding. Bind it first.
It is down. Do not pause.
Finish it. It is not dead yet.
I am counting its health for you.
Hit its legs, and it cannot run.
Well struck. That one will cost it.
Hit. Its claw snapped.
That one put it against the wall.
I flash its eyes. Now.

lines.zh: 它扑空了，反手给它一下。
lines.en: It missed; answer with a backhand.
Your shield caught its teeth.
It's down; I watch it twitch.
The box lights up. Here I am.
First meeting. My name is Verity.
I roll out of the animation box.
Your new assistant is in place.

lines.zh: 按下快捷键，就能听见我。
lines.en: Press the hotkey, and you will hear me.

lines.zh: 我小小一颗，装得下很多话。
lines.en: I am small, but I hold a lot of talk.

lines.zh: 这屋子以后由我帮你看着。
lines.en: I will help you watch this house.
The light is on, so I am awake.
From today, I follow you.
Do not leave me in the chest.

lines.zh: 我出场的时候，总是很亮。
lines.en: I always arrive brightly.
Hello. I can open doors for you.
This yellow ball is yours to command.
What happens in five days, we will not mention.
Too hot. My shell is softening.
I rolled off the table and landed dizzy.
Water is inside my shell. Fish me out.
The blast threw me into the corner.
An arrow pinned itself beside me.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我的灯乱闪。
lines.en: That force makes my light flicker wildly.
I do not eat, so hunger cannot ruin me.
Thunder is loud; my shell rattled.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，抓紧我。
lines.en: There is nothing below. Hold on to me.
